svg.text: Current measured/photo-context model rendered for visual feedback. Approximate elements remain labelled in metadata.

polygon.title: property_boundary; dimensioned_from_legacy_site_plan; Overall site boundary from Matplotlib-005 property dimensions. Boundary position is schematic until cadastral/survey data is added.
boundary_hedges_and_fences; photo_verified_approx; Photo-verified tall hedges/fences along the driveway side and rear/side garden boundaries. These are important shade and privacy constraints.
boundary_hedges_and_fences; photo_verified_approx; Photo-verified tall hedges/fences along the driveway side and rear/side garden boundaries. These are important shade and privacy constraints.

upper_side_driveway; satellite_photo_verified_approx; Satellite/photo-verified main concrete driveway running from the street side along the upper side of the property toward the garage. Replaces the earlier generic path polygon.
front_diagonal_path; satellite_photo_verified_approx; Satellite-visible diagonal concrete path from the driveway/front hardscape toward the sunroom/front-house area.

garage_concrete_pad; satellite_photo_verified_approx; Satellite/photo-verified larger concrete area in front of the garage/cottage line where the driveway/service area opens out. The house-side edge now meets the timber deck's sloping outer edge, matching photos where the deck steps directly onto concrete rather than grass. Edges are approximate pending direct measurements.

garage_cottage_side_path; photo_verified_approx; Photo-verified narrow concrete path running along the house-facing side of the cottage and garage, meeting the larger concrete area. This replaces the incorrect broad rear concrete block.

rear_timber_deck; photo_verified_approx; Photo-verified timber deck outside the kitchen/dining double doors and entrance/laundry side of the house. Updated from House-Outline-Internal-walls-deck.png, using the green satellite annotation offset back to the active model's kitchen/dining wall. Satellite and deck photos show the platform tight to the house with a long diagonal outer edge, a short return near the concrete, and adjacent hardstanding/concrete kept outside the timber footprint. Geometry is approximate until deck edge measurements are taken.

rect.title: cottage_end_deck; photo_verified_approx; Photo-verified small deck/landing at the end of the cottage. Position and size are approximate until measured.

garage_shed; photo_verified_approx; Photo-verified remaining garage/shed at the end of the driveway with visible roller door. Current model places it on the same horizontal line and width as the cottage, with only a small gap to the top boundary.

cottage; photo_verified_satellite_outdated; Photo-verified cottage added after the satellite image was taken. The cottage sits to the right of the garage on the same horizontal line and approximate width, replacing part of the old rear garage footprint. Display geometry is approximate until measured or newer aerial imagery is available.

polygon.title: sunroom; measured_approx; First current-structure slice: measured sunroom shape with photo-verified wraparound glazing.

rect.title: lounge; measured_dimensions_inferred_position; Included only to anchor the photo-verified sunroom-to-lounge slider relationship.

polygon.title: kitchen_dining; measured_dimensions_photo_verified_openings; Promoted after deck-side photos verified the large door group and adjacent glazing. Position remains visually calibrated until full metric alignment is completed.

rect.title: entrance; measured_dimensions_photo_verified; Photo-verified glazed deck-side entrance/back-entry space connected to laundry.
laundry; measured_dimensions_photo_verified; Photo-verified laundry beyond entrance with washing machines, sink/bench, and exterior window.
toilet; measured_dimensions_photo_verified; Photo-verified small toilet room connected from laundry with frosted exterior window.
hallway; measured_dimensions_photo_verified; Photo-verified interior circulation spine connecting lounge/office side toward entrance and laundry, with bathroom sliding door visible on the side wall.

master_bedroom; measured_dimensions_reference_position_photo_context; Measured room dimensions promoted into the current layer. Pixel position follows the calibrated reference plan and is photo-context checked against master bedroom photos and exterior street/front views.

office; measured_dimensions_reference_position_photo_context; Measured room dimensions promoted into the current layer. Pixel position follows the calibrated reference plan and is supported by office photos and hallway doorway photos.

bathroom; measured_dimensions_reference_position_photo_context; Measured bathroom dimensions promoted into the current layer. Pixel position follows the calibrated reference plan and is supported by bathroom photos plus hallway sliding-door evidence.

bedroom_2; measured_dimensions_reference_position_photo_context; Measured room dimensions promoted into the current layer. Pixel position follows the calibrated reference plan and is photo-context checked against bedroom 2 interior photos.

g.title: Dining table and four chairs visible in dining photos.
Kitchen benches, blue cabinetry, pantry/fridge wall, and sink/cooktop run are visible in kitchen photos.
L-shaped lounge sofa pulled off the lower wall to leave a circulation gap behind it, plus coffee table and TV/media wall visible in lounge photos.
Master bed and headboard visible against the dark feature wall.
Bedroom 2 photos show bed/daybed along the pink feature wall with storage/bookcase and open wardrobe on the opposite side.
Office desk, chair, screens, and shelving visible in office photos.
Laundry bench, sink, and two front-loading appliances visible in laundry photos.
Two cars shown because the user confirmed the garage can be represented with two cars.
Small outdoor table/chairs and wicker seating visible on the deck photos.

entrance_deck_slider; photo_verified; Photo-verified deck-side glazed entrance/slider. Display geometry marks the deck-facing edge of the entrance zone.
laundry_to_toilet_door; photo_verified; Photo-verified connection from laundry into toilet; exact swing/opening direction remains approximate.
toilet_frosted_window; photo_verified; Photo-verified frosted toilet window. Display geometry is approximate pending exterior side-wall calibration.
hallway_to_entrance_laundry; photo_verified; Photo-verified hallway continuation toward the entrance/laundry end. Display geometry marks the transitional circulation zone.
hallway_to_bathroom_sliding_door; photo_verified; Photo-verified bathroom sliding door opening off the hallway; exact lateral placement remains approximate until a hallway wall survey.
hallway_to_office_door; photo_verified; Photo-verified office doorway relationship to the hallway. Door swing direction is not yet modelled.
master_street_window; photo_context_approx; Approximate street/front-facing master bedroom window marker. Position needs direct wall/window offset measurement.
master_sunroom_window; photo_context_approx; Approximate master bedroom window facing the sunroom side. Position needs direct wall/window offset measurement.
office_se_window; photo_context_approx; Approximate SE-facing office window marker. Position needs exterior wall/window offset measurement.
bathroom_se_window; photo_context_approx; Approximate SE-facing bathroom window marker. Position needs exterior wall/window offset measurement.
bedroom2_se_window; photo_context_approx; Approximate SE-facing bedroom 2 window marker. Position needs exterior wall/window offset measurement.
